summaries.body:
ASVS 5.0.0 V11.1.3 is new in the release. The official mapping marks it ADDED: verify that cryptographic discovery mechanisms identify every instance of cryptography in the system, including encryption, hashing, and signing. No 4.0.3 predecessor is mapped for this clause.

Git events on this ID are almost entirely slot reuse from other chapters (files/RFI, session cookies, input validation). Mapping is the reliable origin. The one commit that names this 5.0 ID is elarlang’s 2023-12-14 update clarifying 11.1.3 and 11.1.5, pointing at a comment on issue #1203.

On 2023-12-14 elarlang updated and clarified 11.1.3 and 11.1.5, citing https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/issues/1203#issuecomment-1814166047. The input does not include that issue’s body, so the comment is attested only as the reason given on the commit.

No other wording history for this discovery clause is in the mapping or predecessor set. Grammarly, CWSS-column, and files/session commits on the ID did not rewrite it.
